name: Roleplay
author: Ruffiana
Kirin
short: Redbot cog that allows members to perform roleplay actions
description: Perform a command on another user. Ask another user to perform a command on you. Modify settings that determine consent.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each member's roleplay settings: their public, servant, selective and untracked flags, the actions they always allow, and the Discord user IDs in their owner, allowed and blocked lists. It also counts, for each pair of members by Discord user ID, how many times one performed each roleplay action on the other, unless either member is untracked. It also stores, for each roleplay gif a member gave a thumbs up or down on the member site, that vote against the member's Discord user ID; only the member sees their own vote, and staff see only the totals. A gif a member sends in on the member site is posted to a staff review channel on Discord with the member's mention and user ID, and the cog keeps no copy and no record of it. Deletion removes the member's settings, counts and gif votes and their ID from every other member's lists and counts.
